gaps.valueSet: Post-mortem influenza antigen specimen constraints and post-mortem-specific test names
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate; the source HL7 postmortem specimen value set is not implemented, and both post-mortem-specific influenza antigen test-name value sets have no codes. The specimen-dependent post-mortem antigen alternatives in IPM-R1 are omitted while coded clinical-specimen antigen branches remain modeled

gaps.valueSet: Four-fold or greater influenza A or B antibody titer increase between paired acute and convalescent sera collected 10-180 days apart
gaps.reason: the source marks this alternative not operational; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, collection intervals, or four-fold titer rises, so the alternative in IPM-R1 is omitted
